Subject: Deployment mode - HIPAA/BAA & SOC 2 evidence follow-up

Hi Emily / Jacob —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we can align on the right deployment mode for Acme Health:

Key requirements we heard:
- You will be processing PHI (clinical notes + scheduling data) and need a signed BAA.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence required for security controls + audit readiness.
- Audit log retention and export to your SIEM (syslog/S3) is required for 7 years for certain records.
- Data residency preference: US (primary us-east).
- KMS / encryption controls and ability to use customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption are important.

Deployment options we discussed (high level):
1) Hosted API (Redwood-hosted):
   - Pros: fastest to integrate, we can sign a BAA and share SOC 2 report; supports encryption-in-transit and at-rest.
   - Limitations: less network isolation; for high-assurance PHI scenarios you may prefer a Dedicated or Private deployment.
2) Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity / VPC peering):
   - Pros: dedicated GPU pools, VPC peering or private networking options, stronger isolation, support for customer-managed KMS; can meet SLA/throughput needs.
   - Typical fit for teams needing PHI handling with strong isolation while still using Redwood control plane.
3) Private (VPC or on-prem):
   - Pros: full customer-managed networking and control plane (option for on-prem), maximal control for compliance and audits.
   - Consider when you require full isolation or have strict vendor-readiness policies.

Our preliminary recommendation: Given PHI + long retention/audit requirements, start with a Dedicated deployment (VPC peering + CMK) as a pragmatic first step while we scope Private if your security team requires it.

Attachments I will share in follow-up: SOC 2 summary, draft BAA, and a deployment checklist for technical kickoff.

Next steps / asks:
- Please confirm your security team's requested evidence (SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summary, third-party attestation list).
- Can we schedule a technical deep-dive (security + infra) next week? Suggested slots: Tue 2027-03-30 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2027-03-31 13:00-14:00 PT.
- I'll loop in our sales/procurement owner (Marissa) for contracting and Rishi for deployment scoping.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
